ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels in the interior and 15% low-intensity (black) pixels along the margins and median line.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized high-intensity white field across both lobes; low-intensity black perimeter along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; vertical low-intensity band at the median notch; dark vertical streaks on the far left proximal fluke area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; one prominent macro-indentation (notch) on the inner-third of the right fluke trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concavity along the trailing edges curving upward toward sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 parallel, vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the distal-left fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant notch/irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right fluke; focal dark pigmentation cluster on the superior edge of the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical pigmentation line bisecting the white field at the median notch vertex.
